notes.text: The Discord invite link discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk or discord.com/invite/W4qkrNwUMk (also discord.com/invite/lazyicarus) leads to the Lazy Icarus server; it hosts support channels for Kerberos mods (e.g. 'azazel-realm') and Community Beastmen. Subscribe to the role 'Kerberos's Projects' under 'Channels & Roles' for update pings. The Steam items of many mods are unlisted and only linked from their LL pages.

Before support requests, install PJ's Console (Console Commands, Steam 2791241084) and enable 'Enable context viewer' so that script errors appear as red text. Log: script_log_###.txt in the game directory; search for 'BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR'. Kerberos mods write Kerberos_mod_log.txt, Lazy's framework writes li_log.txt.

Recommended complete mod list and load order for playing Miao/Azazel/Alarielle/Katarin: https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/File:Mod_list_and_load_order.png (image, linked by the Kerberos author as a reference).

According to the author, ll-46165 (DeHess) is the current collection; older LL pages with 'Community Beastmen' in the name are outdated. Full version: new_community_beastmen (Steam 3476784883); for non-Beastmen playthroughs community_beastmen_light (download only). Guide on GitHub: RealDeHess/CommunityBeastmen.
